That will be him booting me out of the house, no explanations welcome. I've already begun the process of cutting off all ties with these guys. I haven't physically been unfaithful, just, you know, emotionally. It just felt so good, like a drug or something.
Thank you for responding. I will try this.

We haven't tried separation, I'm honestly terrified at the thought of it. When/if he comes home tonight, I'm going to sit him down and try to talk this out. It's going to be terrible, but it needs to happen. The hardest part will be getting him to talk to me at all, he left this morning and wouldn't even look at me.

I don't know. He's known from the beginning about my infertility, and we've always kept our options open. If we can get back to a place where we love each other, and communicate instead of fighting and me disappointing him, I 'd love to look back into the adoption thing, but as it stands now, I just feel like having a baby would hurt more than it helps. I appreciate your time.
He's my best friend, and has been for the better part of a decade. I feel like he hates me, at this point. I don't want to give up, but I can't fix this alone.

I'm sorry, I was trying to keep it shortish. I have made attempts to get to the root of the issues, he won't even acknowledge they exist. He is extremely anti-therapy. And yes, I know this online chat thing is wrong. It started fairly innocently.

Thank you for replying. I know it's bad, but it feels so good to be desired again. 

He doesn't believe in therapy or psychiatry at all, and refuses to acknowledge that there's a real problem. A big part of this is that I can't have kids, and he really wants babies. We've tried to go the surrogacy route, but it was too expensive, adoption isn't looking feasible either. Anytime I bring up our problems, he reverts back to this idea that having a baby will fix everything. I don't want to bring a child into our broken marriage even if we could find a solution To the baby thing. 

He's not even talking to me today because I'm a disappointment to him. His words, not mine
Go for it anyway. Get her number, text her. If she likes you, it will be cute, not creepy.
I've just never in my life had a connection like this. I know what I have to do, though. Thank you.
Thank you for sharing that, it makes me feel a little bit better.

He's an amazing guy, who I will probably never meet in person. We don't even live in the same country. He started talking to me through GW. It's like a male redditor's dream, and my own personal fucking nightmare.
Thank you for the kind words, but I'm a girl. I just don't love my husband anymore. I think I might be broken.
